report sea surface temperatures, thermal stress on coral, and bathymetry

criteria.reasoning: Clear goals, users (marine and conservation scientists) and need with stats and literature links. Requirements/payload detail limited, so not top of band.

evidence.quote: Project work will be divided into weeks via a Gantt Chart.

criteria.reasoning: Gantt plus task breakdown shows feasibility. No contingency provision, weak justification linked to mission narrative, and future information sources not listed as required.
Only background reading and STK tutorials claimed, no results, plots or interpretation shown. Technical error on orbit undermines progress. Minimal evidence, low Adequate.

evidence.quote: Completed stages are gold. Incomplete stages are blue.

criteria.reasoning: Well-written with headings and consistent formatting. Gantt unnumbered/uncaptioned, footnoted URLs not proper citations, so below professional Accomplished standard.

technical_issues.issue: States 'geostationary orbit at an altitude of 600 km' - technically incorrect; 600 km is LEO, GEO is ~35,786 km, confuses station-keeping over reef.
Timeline inconsistency: text says Weeks 7 and 8 reserved for review and final report due 20/11/20, but Gantt shows Editing & Finalisation in Wk9-10.

overall: Good reef-monitoring concept with users and rationale. Plan feasible but lacks contingencies/sources. Little technical results and major orbit error limit progress.
